Welcome, all, to the Crimson Troupe—

steps.name: Performer C

steps.name: Performer B

steps.name: Performer A

steps.text: I can't remember at all!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Oh, forget it. I'll go borrow some books and see if I can find anything there.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hey there.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Whbuh!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Uh, my bad. Did I just scare you?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: You're... a new operator, I think. Got any troubles, or?

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: S-Sorry about that! It's not your fault. Just my overreaction.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: There's just this question I can't quite figure out, and it's got me a little lost...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Hm? Is it anything I can help you with?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: No need to be reserved about it. Call it my apology for frightening you. I'll listen to what's on your mind, if you want. If I can help with any of it, that's all the better.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Thank you... you're such a nice person!

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Everyone at Rhodes Island really is so kind...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Heheh. Much appreciated.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: What were you saying before about something you couldn't remember?

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: So you heard that. I was thinking about the name of a place... Calais-blason. It gives me the nagging feeling I've heard it before, but I just can't think of where.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Have you heard of any place like that before?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Ah... that is familiar.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I never thought I'd hear that name again.

steps.name: Mint
steps.text: Oh! You know of it?!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Of course. Of course I know of it.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Long, long ago, I used to live there.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I heard someone mouthing off about its name. Saying it's not one people ever mention anymore, how you only remember if you should've been buried long ago in the rotting ruins of the past.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: That person and that mouth are both rotting in the past, if you ask me...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: No, my bad. That was neither here nor there.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Do you have time for a story? I've got one to tell.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: It's about Calais-blason, and about its people. About a group of children who lost their shelter, and about the traveling troupe passing by that little village...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: I can tell you every last bit.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: Let's go somewhere a little quieter first, though.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Operator
steps.text: ...It might be a very long story.
